components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 28px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #ecebe6; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(236 235 230 / 0.14); font: 600 12.5px/1 'Archivo Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms, box-shadow 120ms; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #1c1c21; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(236 235 230 / 0.24); } .ds-btn:active { background: #26262c; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffcc33; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Capsule filter with a count chip that inverts when active; an empty store shows as a dashed ghost.
components.css: .ds-pills { display: flex; gap: 8px; background: #0d0d0f; padding: 12px; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 28px; padding: 0 4px 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #ecebe6; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(236 235 230 / 0.14); font: 600 12.5px/1 'Archivo Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill:hover { background: #1c1c21; } .ds-count { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 22px; height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #1c1c21; color: #8f8f98; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 75%; } .ds-pill.is-active { background: #ecebe6; color: #0d0d0f; box-shadow: none; } .ds-pill.is-active .ds-count { background: #0d0d0f; color: #ecebe6; } .ds-pill.is-empty { color: #8f8f98; box-shadow: none; outline: 1px dashed rgb(236 235 230 / 0.14); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-pill.is-empty .ds-count { background: none; color: #6b6b73; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Title-strip search with its Ctrl F keycaps.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 360px; height: 30px; padding: 0 6px 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: #151518; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(236 235 230 / 0.08); } .ds-search:focus-within { background: #1c1c21; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(236 235 230 / 0.24), 0 0 0 3px rgb(255 204 51 / 0.12); } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: #ecebe6; font: 13px 'Archivo Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; caret-color: #ffcc33; outline: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #8f8f98; } .ds-keys { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-kbd { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: #1c1c21; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(236 235 230 / 0.14), inset 0 -2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); color: #8f8f98; font: 650 10.5px/1 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-stretch: 80%; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.name: Spec Section Head
components.description: Condensed-caps title, a hairline to the edge, and the count.
components.css: .ds-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; background: #0d0d0f; font: 650 11px/1 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-stretch: 72%; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-head h2 { margin: 0; font: inherit; font-weight: 750; color: #ecebe6; } .ds-rule { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: rgb(236 235 230 / 0.14); } .ds-n { color: #8f8f98; }

components.name: Favorite Sticker
components.description: The shrinkwrap sticker: appears on hover, stays filled once the game is a favorite.
components.css: .ds-stickers { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; background: #2a475e; } .ds-sticker { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(13 13 15 / 0.78); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); color: #ecebe6; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms, color 140ms; } .ds-sticker:hover { background: rgb(13 13 15 / 0.92); color: #ffcc33; } .ds-sticker.is-on { background: #ffcc33; color: #1a1405; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), inset 0 -2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12); } .ds-sticker:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffcc33; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Box Front
components.description: The printed fallback tile for missing art: platform gradient, inset frame, mark, Box Type title.
components.html: Solitaire & Casual GamesXbox
components.css: .ds-box { position: relative; width: 184px; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; padding: 22px; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; text-align: center; background: radial-gradient(120% 70% at 50% 0%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(165deg, #1c8a1c, #0f5a10 55%, #082b09); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), 0 10px 22px -14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-box:hover { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-frame { position: absolute; inset: 9px; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.13); } .ds-mark { display: grid; color: #b6f15a; } .ds-title { color: #ecebe6; font: 850 21px/1.02 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-stretch: 80%; text-transform: uppercase; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-plat { position: absolute; bottom: 16px; color: rgb(236 235 230 / 0.66); font: 650 10px/1 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-stretch: 72%; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.description: Boxed notice; errors take a Recall Red edge.

components.css: .ds-notice { display: grid; gap: 3px; width: 380px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 10px; background: #1c1c21; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(236 235 230 / 0.14), 0 18px 40px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-notice strong { color: #ecebe6; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-notice span { color: #8f8f98; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-notice.is-error { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 107 91 / 0.4), 0 18px 40px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8); }

narrative.overview:
Launchbay treats every installed game the way a retail shelf did: covers face out, big and uncropped, and the chrome around them is set like the spec block printed on the back of a boxed PC game (condensed caps, hairline rules, tabular figures, drawn keycaps). The covers carry all the color and drama. The shell stays near-black, quiet and exact, so a wall of dark cover art pops rather than competing with a themed frame.

The system is dense where people scan (the list view reads like a system-requirements table) and generous where people browse (the cover wall, the launch lift-off). Motion is feedback, apart from one authored moment: on launch the cover lifts off the shelf and grows to fill the window, blurred and dimmed, while a disc spins up.

It refuses the category defaults of slate panels, a left rail and blue selection, and of the neon-glow gaming dashboard. It also stays clear of retro costume: no barcodes, rating-box pastiche or fake shrinkwrap gloss. The discipline is type and rules, not props.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black shelf, colorless chrome, one sticker-yellow accent.
Archivo from a single variable family: condensed caps for every label, normal width for game names.
Hairline-ruled spec headers with right-aligned counts divide the shelf.
Face-out 2:3 covers that lift on hover and always fill their tile; missing art becomes a printed box front.
Drawn keycaps for every keyboard hint.

rules.name: The One Sticker Rule
rules.body: Sticker Yellow marks favorites, focus, the primary-action hint and "on" states. It is never decoration, never a fill for a region, and never used for a second meaning.

rules.name: The Colorless Shell Rule
rules.body: The chrome carries no hue of its own. Color comes from the covers and from platform box fronts, never from panels, headers or borders.

rules.name: The Spec Label Rule
rules.body: Every label, head, column title and meta line uses condensed caps. Game names never do; a name is set at normal width so it reads as content, not chrome.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures are tabular and lining everywhere (counts, sizes, playtime), so columns and chips never jitter.

rules.name: The Lift-Off Rule
rules.body: Depth answers state. Nothing floats at rest except the covers, and a cover lifts only when it is hovered, focused or previewing.

dos: Do keep the ground at Shelf Black (#0d0d0f) and let the covers supply color.
Do set every label, head and meta line as condensed caps (Archivo, 72% width, +0.09em) and every game name at normal width.
Do draw keyboard hints as keycaps, in Archivo, never as bare text.
Do print a box front (platform gradient, frame, Box Type title) wherever art is missing, instead of leaving a blank or broken image.
Do keep routine motion at 140–220ms ease-out and save the long, authored motion for the launch.
Do use the 16px gutter as the unit and 24px for the page edge.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue; Sticker Yellow is the only one, and Recall Red is reserved for failure.
Don't add barcodes, rating-box pastiche, faux shrinkwrap gloss or other box props; the world is carried by type and rules.
Don't reach for slate panels, a left rail or blue selection (the category default), or for neon glow.
Don't set game names in condensed caps, or labels in normal width.
Don't use monospace for keycaps or numbers; tabular Archivo covers both.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading; spec heads carry their own weight.
